top5.title: Polymyxin B Attenuates Sepsis-Induced Acute Kidney Injury by Activating a SUMO1-p65 "Molecular Brake" in Kidney Organoids
top5.why: Polymyxin B attenuates sepsis-induced kidney injury through SUMO1-mediated modification of NF-κB p65, suppressing inflammatory gene expression and renal parenchymal damage.

top5.title: Opposing functions of gut immunomodulatory metabolites on CAR-T therapy
top5.why: Low valeric acid and high indole metabolites predict CAR-T therapy failure, with metabolite supplementation shown to enhance or impair CAR-T cell efficacy in functional models.

top5.title: Single-cell multiomics across nine mammals reveals cell-type-specific regulatory conservation in the brain
top5.why: Cell-type-specific enhancers show differential conservation across mammals, with conserved elements enriched for neurodegenerative disease risk and human-specific elements associated with neuropsychiatric traits.

top5.title: Handling biological replicates in long-read RNA sequencing data by joining or not joining
top5.why: Join & Call and Call & Join strategies for consensus isoforms from replicated long-read RNA-seq yield different strengths: joining reads first excels at novel isoform discovery while separate reconstruction suits replication-heavy studies prioritizing known transcripts.

top5.title: Integration of GWAS and single-cell analysis for psoriasis identifies disease-associated cell subtypes and therapeutic targets
top5.why: Meta-analysis identifies 17 new psoriasis susceptibility loci and maps disease-associated genes to specific cell subtypes, prioritizing 50 therapeutic targets with layer-specific activity patterns.

also.title: Global burden of cancer attributable to infections in 2024: a worldwide incidence analysis
also.why: Infections account for 2.3 million cancer cases globally in 2024, with H. pylori, HPV, and HBV predominating, identifying prevention targets and research priorities.

also.title: H(2)S enhances drought resistance by orchestrating alternative splicing and persulfidation of ETFQO
also.why: H2S enhances drought tolerance by inducing alternative splicing of ETFQO to generate isoforms that are differentially persulfidated, coordinating stomatal closure and mitochondrial respiration.

also.title: A human-induced pluripotent stem cell-derived spheroid model to investigate myelin injury and repair
also.why: Human iPSC-derived spheroids with mature oligodendrocytes and microglia enable quantitative study of myelin damage and repair processes previously inaccessible in human systems.

also.title: Spatial evolution of a cachexia-promoting microenvironment in pancreatic cancer
also.why: SEMA4A+ tumor cells, AQP9+ macrophages, and LOXL2+ fibroblasts form a microenvironmental niche whose progressive enrichment correlates with cachexia severity in pancreatic cancer.

also.title: Bispecific antibody-drug conjugates in cancer: therapeutic-window determinants, tumour-immune interactions, and clinical translation
also.why: Izalontamab brengitecan's regulatory approval demonstrates that bispecific antibody-drug conjugates can achieve clinically meaningful therapeutic windows, but enhanced binding alone does not ensure development success.

also.title: Age distribution and regression-associated immunophenotypic features in canine cutaneous histiocytoma
also.why: Lymphocytic infiltration, not age, independently predicts membranous MHC-II expression in canine cutaneous histiocytoma regression.
